Using the generated workbooks

Each copy opens on the original cover, with the student sheets hidden. The student presses the original Generate Data button once in desktop Excel, completes the Solution sheet and saves.

Retain the recorded checksums and private instructor package. Generate and grade in the same browser, or restore the private archive here before grading on another device. Use the separate grading site with the checksum you recorded for that version and the student workbooks; no receipt upload is needed. Distribute only the .xlsm files.

Question order, identifiers, source data and instruction images are bound to each version’s checksum. A checksum identifies the issued content; it does not prove who completed the workbook. Image instructions are an experimental check that vision AI may read.

Only needed on another browser or after site storage is cleared. Select INSTRUCTOR_ONLY/Receipt.json from your private instructor package.
